inventory_scope: Specifically inventories data/raw/day_ahead_prices.csv, data/pv_profile_10mw_2026-08-06_15min.csv, data/processed/hybrid_scenarios_10mw_v1.csv, and JSON files matching data/processed/*.json except this inventory; arbitrary files are not recursively discovered.

files.classification: observed source data; source attribution recorded but URL absent
files.source: SMARD per DATA_SOURCES.md; exact URL and download date unknown

coverage.end_convention: exclusive end boundary of the final 15-minute interval

files.units_and_source_notes: DA price unit is stated in the CSV column header. Source URL, download date, and terms are not verified in repository documentation.

files.classification: stored source-like series plus derived proxy
files.source: Underlying source and derivation script are absent; see DATA_SOURCES.md

pv_national_mw.unit: MW as named; unit and provenance not independently verified
pv_national_mw.classification: stored input column; source status unknown

files.timezone_semantics: unknown; timestamps contain no UTC offset
files.forecast_or_actual: Neither a verified plant actual series nor a verified forecast series. The 10 MW column is a normalized national-profile proxy.

files.classification: derived synthetic scenarios; not empirical joint observations
files.source: Generated by src/smard_scenarios.py from the DA file and repeated one-day PV proxy, plus synthetic clipped Gaussian perturbations
files.temporal_resolution: 15 minutes by integer step; source timestamps are not the scenario clock

source_timestamp_field.timezone_semantics: unknown; values are timezone-naive DA source timestamps
source_timestamp_field.interpretation: sampled source reference, not the scenario interval timestamp
source_timestamp_field.note: Irregular gaps are expected where independently sampled DA blocks are stitched together; use step as the scenario clock.

pv_columns.p_pv_forecast_mw: repeated deterministic normalized proxy; not an observed forecast
pv_columns.p_pv_mw: generated proxy actual with synthetic perturbation; not measured actual
pv_columns.pv_error_mwh_15min: synthetic difference; not empirical forecast error

files.joint_observation_reason: PV values/errors are generated independently of the sampled DA price values; the source files do not contain aligned PV forecast and actual observations.

configuration.pv_data_note: Synthetic 10 MW peak-normalized proxy; no local forecast or forecast error

files.limitation: Derived from synthetic PV scenarios, perfect-foresight recourse, and the explicitly diagnostic DA-equals-imbalance price assumption.

minimum_additional_data: DA price series with documented source, units, resolution, and timezone
PV forecast and realized PV for the same site or explicitly defined proxy
